mapper.select: select t1.type, t1.value, t1.parameter_id, t1.date_type, t1.date_format, t1.start_no, t1.max_length, t1.step, t1.fill_zero, t1.sort, t1.is_show from bp_code_rule_version_detail t1 where t1.code_rule_version_id = #{versionId} order by t1.sort asc

select t1.type, t1.value, t1.parameter_id, t2.dict_value as parameterNo, t1.date_type, t1.date_format, t1.start_no, t1.max_length, t1.step, t1.fill_zero, t1.sort, t1.is_show from bp_code_rule_version_detail t1 left join bp_dict_detail t2 on t1.parameter_id = t2.id where t1.code_rule_version_id = #{versionId} order by t1.sort asc
